<!-- For a new trick, see "Contributing" in the README. -->

- [ ] Type-level only: no runtime logic and no branded types
- [ ] `tricks/<name>/index.ts` has cases that pass and cases marked `// @ts-expect-error`
- [ ] `tricks/<name>/README.md` has a one-line description, "How it works" and "Limits"
- [ ] Root README has a `### [<name>](tricks/<name>)` section
- [ ] Ran `pnpm docs:sync`, and `pnpm check` passes
